newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish April consumer confidence rises.
newsitem.headline: Finnish April consumer confidence rises.

text.p: Finnish consumer confidence rose in April to a record high of 17.1 points from 15.6 points in March, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Wednesday.
"Over half of Finns estimated that the country's economy has improved during the past year. Every other (Finn) believed it would also improve during the next year," SF said.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: personal finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods.
The consumer confidence indicator was 15.9 points in February, 15.5 in January, 13.8 in December and in November.
